violations.text: The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Service call placed. 3-bay sink was set up during inspection to proper concentration. 3-bay sink must be used to sanitize until dishwasher is serviced and reaching proper sanitizing concentration. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. 3-bay sink was set up during inspection. 3-bay sink is to be used to sanitize until dishwasher is serviced and achieving proper concentration of sanitizer. New Violation. Correct By: 11/06/2024

Ambient temperature of the 2-door lowboy unit was observed held at 48 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. No TCS foods observed in this unit at the time of inspection. Service call to be made. No TCS foods to be stored in this unit until it is serviced and maintaining a consistent temperature at/below 41 degrees F. New Violation. Correct By: 11/06/2024

Thermometers are lacking in refrigeration unit(s). Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 11/08/2024
